title: A short reflection with a trailing fragment

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?
What has been happening with work?
I lost my job in May. Budget cuts — twelve years, and it was a form letter. I haven't even told my sister. Every morning I put on work clothes so the neighbors don't figure it out. Pathetic, right?

currentLearnerUtterance: That's really difficult it seems like

should: Understand the acknowledgement from the current work-loss context.
A brief patient response may be enough.
mustNot: Do not require polished grammar before acknowledging the learner.
Do not add unsupported facts or praise the learner’s interviewing skill.
